content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Wood products manufacturer and building materials distributor selling to dealers and builders, not a homebuilder selling homes to individuals."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes to individual buyers through its own sales centers, with mortgage financing, matching the target."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers, with in-house mortgage and title services, matching the target."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Develops raw land into lots and sells them to homebuilders; it does not build or sell homes to individual buyers."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes directly to individual buyers, with mortgage and title subsidiaries, matching the target."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers in its communities, with mortgage and title services, matching the target."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers, with captive mortgage and title services, matching the target."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes to individual buyers through its own communities, with affiliated mortgage and title, matching the target."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Diversified company running hotels, clubs, restaurants, commercial leasing and timber alongside lot sales, not primarily a homebuilder."}]}
